about.label: Our story
about.body: DiMOE was born from a simple idea: bring real Neapolitan pizza to southern Santiago. No shortcuts. Slow-fermented dough that earns its time, and ingredients that make all the difference.
about.h1_desc: Fresh mozzarella, San Marzano tomatoes and slow-fermented dough. Zero compromises.
about.h2_desc: Recognized by @thetopchile among the best restaurants in the country.
about.h3_desc: Your pet is welcome on our outdoor terrace. More space, better atmosphere.
about.h4_desc: Vegetarian and vegan options on the menu so no one is left out.
about.banner_desc: Darío Pavez 16, Champa, Paine · 🚗 Free parking · 🚉 5 min from Metrotren
